'''Lumo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point he was enslaved by [[Nova Blades]] pirates and forced to mine [[Exonium/Legends|Exonium]] for them. In [[3637 BBY]] an individual incited a rebellion among the slaves kept by Nova Blades on a remote island, but Lumo warned their rescuer that Slavemaster [[Kendruh]] kept the records of the slaves' families to punish them in case the slaves rebelled and escaped. After the individual killed Kendruh and retrieved his journal, Lumo and the other slaves joined the rebellion in full force.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lumo appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
